results.title: US 30-year bond yield hits highest level since Treasury ended bond in 2001
results.description: US 30-year Treasury yields hit 5.216% at Thursday’s $25 billion auction, the highest since 2001, as investors demand higher returns amid rising debt, deficits and inflation risks in markets.
